sum: This study utilizes high-spatial-resolution structural, kinematic, and throw measurements to investigate the Roccapreturo normal fault system in the Central Apennines, Italy. By analyzing strike, dip, slip vectors, and Holocene/geological throw profiles, the authors find highly variable fault geometry, including steeper dips within a relay zone that suggest sub-surface connectivity between strands. Strain rate calculations show smooth variations despite complex surface geometry, indicating coupled fault geometry and slip. The findings highlight how high-resolution mapping can resolve fault maturity and sub-surface linkage, which are critical for assessing potential earthquake rupture dynamics and seismic hazards.
本研究利用高空间分辨率的结构、运动学和断距测量数据，对意大利中亚平宁山脉的Roccapreturo正断层系统进行了调查。通过分析走向、倾角、滑动矢量以及全新世和地质断距剖面，作者发现断层几何结构具有高度可变性，包括接替带内较陡的倾角，这表明断层分段在地下是相连的。应变率计算显示，尽管地表几何结构复杂……

t: High-spatial-resolution structural mapping, kinematic measurements of slip vectors, and construction of Holocene and geological throw profiles to calculate strain rates.
采用高空间分辨率结构制图、滑动矢量运动学测量，以及构建全新世和地质断距剖面来计算应变率。
Structural (strike/dip) and kinematic (slip vector) measurements, 12 Holocene throw profiles, and 7 geological cross-sections from the Roccapreturo fault system, Italy.
源自意大利Roccapreturo断裂系统的结构与运动学测量数据、12条全新世断距剖面和7个地质剖面。
Maximum Holocene throw of 8.75 ± 1.75 m (0.58 ± 0.16 mm/yr rate), maximum geological throw of 610 m, and smooth strain rate variations indicating coupled geometry and slip.
最大全新世断距为8.75±1.75米（速率0.58±0.16毫米/年），最大地质断距为610米，应变率平滑变化。
Inferences of sub-surface connectivity are based on surface geometry and throw profiles rather than direct subsurface geophysical imaging.
地下连通性的推断主要基于地表几何和断距剖面，而非直接的深部地球物理成像。
Demonstrates that high-resolution mapping can resolve sub-surface fault linkage and maturity, showing smooth strain rates across complex surface geometries.
证明了高分辨率制图能解析地下断层连通性与成熟度，揭示了复杂地表几何下平滑变化的应变率。

kc: Presented a high-spatial-resolution structural and kinematic database for the Roccapreturo normal fault system.
Provided evidence of sub-surface connectivity between fault strands based on steeper dips within a relay zone.
Calculated Holocene and geological throw rates, showing smooth strain rate variations that imply coupled fault geometry and slip.
提供了Roccapreturo正断层系统的高空间分辨率结构和运动学数据库。
基于接替带内较陡的倾角变化，提供了断层分段在地下深部相连的证据。
计算了全新世和地质断距速率，显示出平滑的应变率变化，表明断层几何与滑动存在耦合。
me: High-resolution structural mapping of fault strike and dip.
Kinematic measurements of the trend and plunge of slip vectors.
Collection of Holocene throw profiles and geological cross-sections to calculate strain rates.
断层走向和倾角的高分辨率结构制图。
滑动矢量趋势和倾角的运动学测量。
收集全新世断距剖面和地质剖面以计算应变率。
de: Structural and kinematic measurements along the Roccapreturo fault system, Italy.
Twelve Holocene throw profiles and seven geological cross-sections.
沿意大利Roccapreturo断裂系统的结构和运动学测量数据。
12条全新世断距剖面和7个地质横截面。
li: The study relies primarily on surface and near-surface observations to infer deep sub-surface connectivity without direct deep geophysical imaging.
该研究主要依赖地表和浅地表观测来推断深部地下连通性，缺乏直接的深部地球物理成像验证。

tm.why: The paper investigates fault geometry, sub-surface connectivity, and structural maturity of an active normal fault system.
Understanding fault linkage and geometry is directly applied to assessing earthquake rupture dynamics and seismic hazard.

ev.notes: No PDF was available; analysis is based entirely on the peer-reviewed abstract and metadata from EarthArXiv.

sum: This study evaluates the impact of realistic 3D structure, including seafloor topography and structural heterogeneity, on slip inversion, stress drop, and tsunami excitation for the 2011 Tohoku earthquake. Using 3D finite-element analysis and slip inversion, the authors show that incorporating 3D structure reduces the maximum slip by ~20% and shifts the peak slip ~20 km landward compared to homogeneous half-space models. While average stress drop and magnitude remain similar, tsunami excitation is strongly affected by seafloor topography, whereas subsurface elastic heterogeneity has a minor effect. Conversely, fault stress drop is modulated by along-strike variations in both factors, demonstrating that half-space assumptions can introduce significant bias in detailed rupture processes.
本研究评估了真实三维结构（包括海底地形和结构非均匀性）对2011年东北大地震滑移反演、应力降和海啸激发的影响。通过三维有限元分析和滑移反演，作者发现，与均匀半空间模型相比，引入三维结构使最大滑移量减少了约20%，并将滑移峰值向陆地方向移动了约20公里。虽然平均应力降和震级保持相似，但海啸激发受海底地……

t: 3D slip inversion and finite-element analysis incorporating realistic seafloor topography and subsurface elastic heterogeneity.
结合真实海底地形和地下弹性非均匀性的三维有限元滑移反演分析方法。
Observational and structural data from the 2011 Tohoku earthquake, modeled using 3D finite-element grids.
2011年日本东北大地震的同震形变与结构模型数据。
3D structure reduces maximum slip by ~20%, shifts the peak ~20 km landward, and modulates stress drop along-strike.
三维结构使最大滑移量减少约20%并向陆地偏移20公里，且地形显著影响海啸激发。
Simplifications in half-space assumptions capture first-order features but introduce significant bias in detailed rupture processes.
传统的半空间假设在精细破裂过程和应力降计算中会引入显著偏差。
Quantifying the distinct, competing impacts of seafloor topography versus subsurface elastic heterogeneity on both tsunami excitation and fault stress drop.
定量区分并揭示了海底地形与地下介质非均匀性对海啸激发和断层应力降的不同影响。

kc: Demonstrated that incorporating 3D structure reduces peak slip by ~20% and shifts its location ~20 km landward for the 2011 Tohoku earthquake.
Revealed that tsunami excitation is significantly affected by seafloor topography, while subsurface elastic heterogeneity plays a minor role.
Showed that fault stress drop is modulated by along-strike variations in both topography and subsurface heterogeneity.
证实了引入三维结构使2011年东北地震的最大滑移量减少约20%，并将峰值位置向陆地方向移动约20公里。
揭示了海啸激发显著受到海底地形的影响，而地下弹性非均匀性的影响较小。
表明断层应力降受到地形和地下非均匀性沿走向变化的共同调制。
me: 3D slip inversion analysis incorporating realistic seafloor topography and structural heterogeneity.
3D finite-element modeling (FEM) to calculate coseismic deformation, stress change, and tsunami excitation.
结合真实海底地形和结构非均匀性的三维滑移反演分析。
用于计算同震形变、应力变化和海啸激发的三维有限元模拟（FEM）。
de: Numerical modeling and inversion applied to the case of the 2011 Tohoku megathrust earthquake.
针对2011年东北大地震案例进行的数值模拟与反演。
li: The study is focused on a single megathrust event (Tohoku), and the generalizability to other subduction zones requires further validation.
该研究专注于单次特大逆冲地震（东北地震），其推广到其他俯冲带的适用性仍需进一步验证。

tm.why: The paper investigates the impact of 3D structure on earthquake slip inversion, stress drop, and tsunami excitation for the 2011 Tohoku earthquake.
The paper models tsunami excitation and coseismic sea-surface deformation, which falls under environmental/tsunami hazards.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the detailed abstract and metadata available from Crossref and Semantic Scholar, as no PDF was provided.

sum: The authors present a physics-guided deep learning framework for efficient Bayesian geophysical inversion. By integrating Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) sampling with an active learning paradigm, the method dynamically expands its training dataset with informative samples and their forward responses. A supervised deep learning model is trained using the Jensen-Shannon divergence as a loss function under a Gaussian assumption. Tested on a seismic velocity model inversion, the workflow successfully reconstructs geological features and velocity distributions with high computational efficiency, requiring only a small fraction of the data compared to full-cube MCMC.
本文提出了一种用于地球物理反演的物理引导深度学习框架。该方法将马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）采样与主动学习相结合，通过随机采样器输出及其正演响应动态扩展训练集。采用以Jensen-Shannon散度为损失函数的监督深度学习模型，并在高斯假设下进行解析计算。在地震速度模型反演测试中，该工作流成功重建了……

t: A physics-guided deep learning framework integrating MCMC sampling with active learning, using Jensen-Shannon divergence as a loss function under a Gaussian assumption.
结合MCMC采样与主动学习的物理引导深度学习框架，在高斯假设下以JS散度为损失函数。
Synthetic seismic velocity model data used to test the inversion workflow and reconstruct geological features.
用于测试反演工作流并重建地质特征的合成地震速度模型数据。
The workflow successfully captured velocity distributions matching the reference model with significantly higher computational efficiency than full-cube MCMC.
成功捕获了与参考模型一致的速度分布，且计算效率显著高于全数据MCMC。
The framework assumes a Gaussian distribution for analytical computation of the Jensen-Shannon divergence loss.
损失函数的解析计算依赖于简化的高斯分布假设。
Combining self-supervised active learning with stochastic MCMC sampling to dynamically expand training data for efficient Bayesian geophysical inversion.
将自监督主动学习与随机MCMC采样结合，动态扩展训练数据以实现高效贝叶斯反演。

kc: Developed a physics-guided deep learning framework that integrates MCMC sampling with active learning for efficient uncertainty quantification.
Introduced a dynamic training dataset expansion strategy using stochastic sampler outputs and their corresponding forward responses.
Utilized the Jensen-Shannon divergence as a loss function with a Gaussian assumption for analytical computation in supervised learning.
开发了一种将MCMC采样与主动学习相结合的物理引导深度学习框架，用于高效的不确定性定量评估。
引入了利用随机采样器输出及其对应正演响应动态扩展训练数据集的策略。
在监督学习中采用以Jensen-Shannon散度为损失函数并结合高斯假设进行解析计算的方法。
me: Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) sampling for Bayesian uncertainty quantification.
Active learning paradigm to select diverse and informative training samples.
Supervised deep learning with Jensen-Shannon divergence loss function.
用于贝叶斯不确定性定量评估的马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）采样。
用于选择多样且富含信息量训练样本的主动学习范式。
采用Jensen-Shannon散度损失函数的监督深度学习。
de: Synthetic seismic velocity model inversion to capture geological features and velocity distributions.
用于捕获地质特征和速度分布的合成地震速度模型反演。
li: The analytical computation of the loss function relies on a simplifying Gaussian assumption which may not hold for highly non-linear or multi-modal posterior distributions.
损失函数的解析计算依赖于简化的高斯假设，这在高度非线性或多峰后验分布中可能不成立。

tm.why: The paper develops a physics-guided deep learning framework incorporating MCMC sampling to assess uncertainty in geophysical inversion.
The framework utilizes a supervised deep learning model and self-supervised active learning to accelerate the inversion process.
The study focuses on improving the computational efficiency of geophysical inversion and Bayesian inference.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the complete abstract and metadata from GJI, Crossref, and Semantic Scholar as no PDF was available.

sum: This paper presents a leakage-audited earthquake forecasting experiment in the Sea of Marmara using a strictly causal KOERI catalog (2003–2026). Addressing the issue of data leakage in machine learning (ML) seismology, the authors design a machine-checkable causality gate. They compare ML models against a conditional cascade Monte-Carlo ETAS forecaster. The results show that ML models do not outperform a properly-fit ETAS model in information gain. An information-arrival analysis applied to the 2025 Mw 6.2 Kumburgaz earthquake reveals that while spatial localization is detectable far in advance, specific timing is highly constrained by foreshock physics, with a 42x probability gain triggered only ten minutes before the mainshock by a lone M4.5 foreshock.
本文在马尔马拉海开展了防数据泄漏的地震预测实验。作者基于严格因果的KOERI地震目录，设计了可自动检测的因果门，以解决机器学习（ML）中的数据泄漏问题。研究对比了ML与条件级联蒙特卡洛ETAS模型，发现ML在信息增益上并未超越拟合良好的ETAS。对2025年Mw 6.2地震的信息到达分析表明，空间定……

t: A leakage-audited forecasting framework utilizing a machine-checkable causality gate to benchmark machine learning against a conditional cascade Monte-Carlo ETAS model.
采用防泄漏预测框架，利用可机器检查的因果门，将机器学习与条件级联蒙特卡洛ETAS模型进行对比基准测试。
A strictly causal, homogenized KOERI earthquake catalog containing 31,329 events (2003–2026) in the Sea of Marmara region.
使用马尔马拉海地区严格因果且均匀化的KOERI地震目录，包含2003至2026年间的31,329个地震事件。
ML does not beat ETAS in information gain (-0.38 nats/event); spatial localization is resolved early, but timing is limited by foreshock physics (42x gain 10 minutes before mainshock).
ML在信息增益上未超越ETAS；空间定位可提前预知，但发震时间预测受限于前震物理学（主震前10分钟获得42倍增益）。
Negative results include ML underperforming ETAS on rare targets, no gain from static GNSS strain, and spatial coverage miss for out-of-box sequences.
负面结果包括ML在稀有目标上表现不及ETAS、静态GNSS应变无增益以及对区域外序列的空间覆盖遗漏。
Introduction of a machine-checkable causality gate to prevent ML data leakage and an information-arrival analysis to track forecast visibility over lead times.
首次引入防止ML数据泄漏的可机器检查因果门，以及用于评估预测显现时间的信息到达分析方法。

kc: Designed a machine-checkable causality gate to prevent data leakage in machine-learning earthquake forecasting.
Developed a conditional cascade Monte-Carlo forecaster that outperforms first-generation ETAS on M>=3.5 targets.
Introduced an information-arrival analysis to measure when and how a target event becomes visible above background hazard.
Demonstrated that machine learning models do not outperform properly-fit ETAS models in information gain for rare targets.
设计了可机器检查的因果门，以防止机器学习地震预测中的数据泄漏。
开发了条件级联蒙特卡洛预测器，在M>=3.5目标上的表现优于第一代ETAS。
引入了信息到达分析，用以衡量目标事件何时以及通过何种观测物理量显现于背景危险之上。
证实了在稀有目标预测中，机器学习模型在信息增益上并未超越拟合良好的ETAS模型。
me: Causality-gated machine learning model training and testing.
Conditional cascade Monte-Carlo ETAS forecasting.
Information-arrival analysis for lead-time and observable tracking.
Conditional 'bigger-event-ahead' discriminator trained on renewal-timed synthetic sequences.
因果门约束的机器学习模型训练与测试。
条件级联蒙特卡洛ETAS预测方法。
用于追踪提前期和可观测物理量的信息到达分析。
在更新时间序列合成数据上训练的条件“前方有更大事件”判别器。
de: Used a strictly causal, homogenized KOERI earthquake catalog containing 31,329 events from 2003 to 2026 in the Sea of Marmara.
Tested forecasting performance on the 23 April 2025 Mw 6.2 Kumburgaz earthquake and the 2025 Sındırgı sequence.
Evaluated static GNSS strain data as a potential forecasting input.
使用了马尔马拉海地区2003年至2026年包含31,329个事件的严格因果、均匀化的KOERI地震目录。
在2025年4月23日Mw 6.2 Kumburgaz地震和2025年Sındırgı序列上测试了预测性能。
评估了静态GNSS应变数据作为预测输入的潜在价值。
li: Machine learning models failed to outperform ETAS on rare, large-magnitude targets.
Static GNSS strain data provided no measurable gain in forecasting performance.
The system missed spatial coverage for the out-of-box Sındırgı sequence.
机器学习模型在稀有的大震目标上未能超越ETAS模型。
静态GNSS应变数据未对预测性能带来可测量的提升。
系统对区域外的Sındırgı序列存在空间覆盖遗漏。

tm.why: The paper focuses on earthquake forecasting experiments using a strictly causal, homogenized KOERI catalog.
The paper benchmarks machine learning models against ETAS models for earthquake forecasting.
The paper evaluates short-term earthquake forecasting and probability gains in the high-hazard Sea of Marmara region.

sum: This study introduces a conditional Generative Adversarial Network (cGAN) framework designed to reconstruct 3D porous media volumes with controlled porosity using only 2D thin section images. By combining property-conditioned generation with 2D-to-3D reconstruction, the method bypasses the need for expensive 3D training datasets. The architecture features a 3D generator and a 2D discriminator, utilizing multi-axis slice extraction to ensure 3D consistency. Porosity labels are derived via an Enhanced U-Net segmentation model. Tested on dolomite-anhydrite and pure dolomite carbonate samples, the framework successfully captured complex lithological features and achieved high porosity control accuracy ($R^2 = 0.93$), demonstrating its utility for digital rock physics and reservoir characterization.
本研究提出了一种条件生成对抗网络（cGAN）框架，仅利用2D薄片图像即可重构出孔隙度可控的3D多孔介质。该方法将物性约束生成与2D到3D重构相结合，避免了昂贵的3D训练数据。该框架采用3D生成器和2D判别器的混合架构，通过多轴切片提取来学习3D一致性结构，并利用改进的U-Net进行孔隙度标注。在白云……

t: A hybrid cGAN architecture combining a 3D generator and a 2D discriminator with multi-axis slice extraction and an Enhanced U-Net for porosity segmentation.
结合3D生成器和2D判别器的混合cGAN架构，利用多轴切片提取和改进的U-Net进行孔隙度分割。
Two carbonate rock samples with different lithologies (dolomite-anhydrite and pure dolomite) represented by 2D thin section images.
采用两种不同岩性（白云岩-硬石膏和纯白云岩）的碳酸盐岩2D薄片图像数据集。
Successful 3D volume generation with controlled porosity achieving an R2 of 0.93, and low mean absolute errors (0.019 and 0.010) for the samples.
成功重构出孔隙度可控的3D体积，孔隙度控制R2达到0.93，平均绝对误差极低。
The method is trained exclusively on 2D images, which may limit its ability to capture complex, fully connected 3D fluid flow pathways.
仅依赖2D图像进行训练，可能在捕获复杂的、完全连通的3D流体通道方面存在局限。
Combining property-conditioned generation with 2D-to-3D reconstruction, eliminating the need for expensive 3D training data.
将物性约束生成与2D到3D重构相结合，消除了对昂贵3D训练数据的依赖。

kc: Developed a hybrid cGAN architecture with a 3D generator and 2D discriminator for 2D-to-3D porous media reconstruction.
Eliminated the requirement for expensive 3D training data by training exclusively on 2D thin section images.
Achieved precise control over petrophysical properties (porosity) during the 3D reconstruction process.
开发了一种结合3D生成器和2D判别器的混合cGAN架构，用于2D到3D的多孔介质重构。
通过完全在2D薄片图像上进行训练，消除了对昂贵3D训练数据的需求。
在3D重构过程中实现了对岩石物理性质（孔隙度）的精确控制。
me: Conditional Generative Adversarial Network (cGAN) with a hybrid 3D generator and 2D discriminator.
Multi-axis slice extraction to enforce 3D structural consistency from 2D training slices.
Enhanced U-Net segmentation model for automated porosity label extraction.
采用混合3D生成器和2D判别器的条件生成对抗网络（cGAN）。
利用多轴切片提取技术，从2D训练切片中约束并学习3D结构一致性。
使用改进的U-Net分割模型进行自动孔隙度标签提取。
de: Demonstrated on two carbonate rock samples with distinct lithologies: a heterogeneous dolomite-anhydrite and a homogeneous pure dolomite.
在两种具有不同岩性的碳酸盐岩样品上进行了演示：非均质白云岩-硬石膏和均质纯白云岩。
li: The reconstruction performance and structural consistency heavily rely on the statistical representativeness of the input 2D thin sections.
重构性能和结构一致性严重依赖于输入的2D薄片在统计学上的代表性。

tm.why: The paper uses conditional Generative Adversarial Networks (cGANs) and U-Net models to reconstruct 3D porous media from 2D images, which is a core machine learning application in rock physics.
Reconstructing 3D porous media and controlling petrophysical properties like porosity is highly relevant to reservoir characterization and rock physics.

sum: The authors apply the Coda Calibration Tool to calibrate coda envelopes for shallow earthquakes in mainland Alaska, referencing NEIC moment magnitudes and spectral ratio apparent stress estimates. This calibration corrects for path attenuation (Q) to yield consistent source spectra across surface and borehole stations. They calculate Mw for 700 events and apparent stress for 200 events, establishing a new orthogonal regression relationship between Mw and ML. To isolate spatial variations in tectonic stress, they introduce detrended apparent stress parameters (ψa and φa) that remove magnitude and depth dependencies. The results reveal elevated apparent stress in south-central Alaska, the Kaktovik region of northern Alaska, and along the Tintina fault.
本文利用尾波包络校正工具（CCT）对阿拉斯加大陆的浅源地震进行校正，获得了700个地震的矩震级（Mw）和200个地震的视应力。该方法有效消除了地表台站低Q值衰减的影响，使地表与井下台站的震源谱高度一致。研究建立了适用于阿拉斯加的Mw与ML正交回归转换关系，并引入了消除震级与深度相关性的新型视应力参数……

t: Coda envelope calibration using the Coda Calibration Tool (CCT) to correct for path attenuation and site effects, combined with orthogonal regression for magnitude conversion.
利用尾波校正工具（CCT）进行尾波包络校正以消除衰减与场址效应，并结合正交回归进行震级转换。
Waveform data from surface and borehole stations in Alaska, calibrated using ~70 reference Mw events and 13 reference apparent stress estimates.
阿拉斯加地表和井下台站的波形数据，基于约70个参考Mw地震和13个参考视应力值进行校正。
Calculated Mw for 700 events and apparent stress for 200 events, revealing high apparent stress in south-central Alaska, northern Alaska, and the Tintina fault.
计算了700个地震的Mw和200个地震的视应力，发现阿拉斯加中南部、北部及廷蒂纳断裂带视应力偏高。
The derived calibration parameters and empirical scaling relationships are restricted to shallow earthquakes within mainland Alaska.
所得的校正参数和经验转换关系仅适用于阿拉斯加大陆区域的浅源地震。
Introduction of magnitude- and depth-detrended apparent stress parameters (ψa and φa) to isolate pure spatial tectonic stress variations.

sum: This study integrates petrographic, geochemical, and petrophysical data to evaluate how lava emplacement styles and post-emplacement alteration control the reservoir properties of the Serra Geral Group basalts in southern Brazil. The Torres Formation, characterized by compound pāhoehoe lobes, exhibits low alteration, low porosity (~1.5%), and high P-wave velocities (~5.9 km/s). In contrast, the Vale do Sol Formation consists of thick rubbly pāhoehoe flows with glass-rich autobrecciated crusts, showing open-system behavior, higher porosity (up to 28%), and highly variable P-wave velocities (2.96–5.37 km/s). The results demonstrate that primary emplacement textures and secondary mineralization control elastic properties, highlighting rubbly pāhoehoe flows as the most favorable horizons for subsurface fluid storage.

sum: This study analyzes continuous seismic records in the Eastern Mediterranean using wavefield coherence. The authors identify a previously unknown, persistent narrowband seismic signal at 0.03 Hz that has been active over a 15-year period. The signal originates from the Nile Fan, a region known for deep fluid reservoirs and active seafloor fluid seepage. To explain the physical mechanism, the authors model the signal as the resonance of a kilometer-scale, fluid-filled crack. They also document a significant seasonal modulation of the signal's strength, highlighting a dynamic interaction between solid Earth fluid processes and oceanic activity.

15 years of continuous seismic records from the Eastern Mediterranean region.

sum: This article serves as the preface to the Focus Section on Environmental Seismology in Seismological Research Letters (SRL). It introduces a collection of papers that explore the application of seismological methods to study surface processes, including cryospheric dynamics, mass wasting, fluvial processes, atmospheric-solid Earth coupling, and anthropogenic noise. The preface outlines the scope of environmental seismology and highlights how modern dense arrays and fiber-optic technologies are advancing the field.

sum: This study uses crustal-scale analog modeling to investigate the formation of V-shaped rifts far from plate tectonic rotational poles, using the South China Sea (SCS) as a prototype. The authors demonstrate that the diachronous, eastward-younging, and narrowing V-shaped opening of the SCS was governed by the combined effects of differential extension (driven by along-strike variations in Proto-SCS subduction) and inherited lithospheric strength heterogeneities. Specifically, weak remnants of Mesozoic magmatic arcs in the east and strong continental basement blocks in the west acted as key structural-rheological controls on strain localization and crustal thinning, regulating the necking along the continent-ocean boundary.
本研究采用地壳尺度物理模拟方法，以南海为原型，探讨远离板块旋转极点的V型裂谷形成机制。结果表明，南海自东向西的渐进式、东部年轻且变窄的V型开裂受控于差异伸展（由古南海俯冲的走向变化驱动）与继承性岩石圈强度非均匀性的联合作用。东部中生代岩浆弧残余弱区与西部强大陆基底块体作为关键的结构-流变控制因素，主……

sum: This study investigates volcano-tectonic interactions in the Natron Rift (East African Rift System) using PyLith to model crustal deformation. By simulating magma reservoir deflation (2007–2008) and inflation (2016–2023) at Ol Doinyo Lengai volcano, the authors compare 3D models incorporating topography and heterogeneous material properties against GNSS observations. The heterogeneous model with topography provides the best fit. Coulomb stress calculations reveal that magma deflation can trigger oblique normal slip on the Natron Fault (stress increase >0.1 MPa), whereas inflation suppresses slip due to increased normal compressive stress. Topography significantly influences these stress changes because the reservoir depth is comparable to the topographic relief.
本研究利用PyLith有限元软件模拟了东非裂谷纳特龙段的岩浆-构造相互作用。研究团队对比了包含与不包含地形、均匀与非均匀介质属性的3D地壳形变模型，并利用2016-2023年GNSS观测数据进行约束。结果表明，考虑地形和非均匀介质的模型拟合度最好。库仑应力计算显示，伦盖火山岩浆库的收缩会使相邻纳特龙……

t: 3D crustal deformation and Coulomb stress modeling using the open-source finite-element code PyLith, comparing homogeneous and heterogeneous material properties with and without topography.
利用开源有限元软件PyLith进行三维地壳形变与库仑应力建模，对比了考虑地形与介质非均匀性的响应。
GNSS surface displacement measurements from 2016 to 2023 in the Natron Rift, East Africa, capturing the inflation phase of the Ol Doinyo Lengai volcano.
使用东非纳特龙裂谷2016至2023年间的GNSS地表位移观测数据，约束火山膨胀形变。

Coulomb stress changes are highly sensitive to topography, meaning simplified flat-Earth models introduce significant stress calculation errors for shallow reservoirs.

Demonstrating that incorporating topography and heterogeneous material properties is essential for accurately modeling stress transfer and fault triggering in early-phase rifts.

sum: This study presents new broadband magnetotelluric (MT) data from a 90 km transect across the Santa Quitéria Continental Magmatic Arc in the NW Borborema Province, Brazil. Phase tensor analysis indicates a 3D geoelectric structure, prompting 3D inversion. The resulting resistivity model reveals a heterogeneous crust down to 25 km depth, featuring five conductive and five resistive domains. A prominent westward-dipping conductor (C1) east of the arc is interpreted as a fossil subduction zone with westward polarity. Other conductors are linked to graphite films in high-pressure rocks. Integrating these results with surface geology, the authors propose a single west-dipping subduction system where coesite-bearing retroeclogites exhumed via contrasting pathways (subduction channel vs. diapiric relamination), resolving a long-standing debate on regional paleosubduction polarity.
本研究利用巴西博博雷马省西北部横跨圣基特里亚大陆岩浆弧的90公里宽频大地电磁（MT）剖面数据，通过3D反演构建了深达25公里的地壳电阻率模型。模型揭示了交替分布的导电和高阻体，其中岩浆弧东侧显著的西倾导电异常（C1）被解释为西向俯冲的古俯冲带。结合地表地质，该研究提出了单一西倾俯冲系统模型，解释了超……

sum: This study investigates the metamorphic sole of the Tinos Ophiolite in the Cyclades, Greece, to understand the relationship between ancient earthquakes and deformation processes along subduction interfaces. By analyzing structural, petrological, and microstructural records within the metamorphic sole, the authors reconstruct the stress, temperature, and fluid conditions during deformation. The work highlights how localized shear zones and brittle-ductile transitions record paleoseismic events, providing critical field-based constraints on the mechanical behavior of subduction zones.
本研究调查了希腊基克拉泽斯群岛蒂诺斯蛇绿岩的变质底部，以理解俯冲带界面中古地震与变形过程之间的关系。通过分析变质底部内的结构、岩石学和微观结构记录，作者重建了变形期间的应力、温度和流体条件。该工作强调了局域化剪切带和脆韧性转变如何记录古地震事件，为俯冲带的力学行为提供了关键的野外约束。

sum: This study performs a stress tensor inversion using a 28-year dataset of F-net CMT focal mechanisms from intermediate-depth and deep earthquakes beneath southwestern Japan. While most of the subducting Pacific slab exhibits a down-dip compression regime parallel to the subduction direction (indicating resistance forces), anomalous regions beneath Takayama and Wakasa Bay show nearly horizontal optimal compression axes parallel to the slab strike. These localized stress anomalies provide strong seismological evidence supporting geodynamic models of tearing or thinning within the subducting Pacific slab.
本研究利用日本西南部中深源地震28年的F-net CMT震源机制解数据进行了应力张量反演。结果表明，该区域大部分太平洋板块呈现与俯冲方向一致的下倾挤压应力状态，表明存在俯冲阻力。然而，在高山和若狭湾下方，最佳挤压轴几乎水平且平行于板块走向。这些局部的异常应力场为太平洋俯冲板块内部存在撕裂或变薄的动力……

sum: This study investigates the 2025 Mw 6.8 Sanriku-Oki earthquake sequence along the Japan Trench using high-resolution S-net seafloor seismic data. The author tracks the spatial-temporal evolution of foreshocks, the mainshock, and aftershocks. Seismicity began 10 days prior to the mainshock, with a 20 km expansion in the final 2 days indicating nucleation near the creep-lock transition. The mainshock and a Mw 6.4 event ruptured in opposite directions from the foreshock zone. Rapid post-seismic expansion of aftershocks to 75 km within 12 hours and the reactivation of repeating earthquakes suggest significant long-range afterslip. The findings highlight the complex, coupled interaction between seismic rupture and heterogeneous aseismic slip processes.

sum: This study evaluates the feasibility of detecting tectonic gravity changes from ongoing rifting in the Gulf of Aden using the upcoming MAGIC satellite mission. By employing 3D finite element and gravitational modeling, the authors show that horizontal motion between oceanic and continental crusts generates a gravity rate of change with peak amplitudes of ±40 nGal/yr. Propagating this signal into orbit simulations with instrumental noise, they demonstrate that MAGIC's instrumentation is sensitive enough to identify a central gravity rate bump of ~6 nGal/yr at a maximum harmonic degree of 70, despite spatial resolution limits and potential temporal aliasing from other geophysical processes.
本研究评估了利用未来的MAGIC卫星任务探测亚丁湾持续裂谷作用引起的构造重力变化的可行性。通过三维有限元和重力建模，研究表明海洋与大陆地壳之间的水平运动会产生峰值振幅达±40 nGal/yr的重力变化率。将该信号传播到包含仪器噪声的轨道模拟中，结果表明，尽管存在空间分辨率限制以及其他地球物理过程的时……

Demonstrates that steady, non-episodic tectonic rifting processes can induce measurable gravity variations detectable by next-generation satellite gravimetry.

sum: This study investigates the shallow crustal structure of the Dongguan Basin (DGB) in South China using a dense seismic array. By applying double-beamforming (DBF) and horizontal-to-vertical spectral ratio (HVSR) methods to ambient noise data, the authors construct a 3D shear-wave velocity (VS) model from Rayleigh-wave dispersion curves. The model clearly delineates basin-bounding faults and reveals low-velocity anomalies at fault intersections, indicating structural complexity and fluid activity. The results show that bedrock is deeper in the east, whereas Quaternary sediments are thicker in the west. This inverse relationship suggests early differential crustal extension followed by sediment transport from the Pearl River, providing critical constraints on basin geometry, fault systems, and local seismic hazards.
本研究利用密集地震台阵探讨了华南东莞盆地的浅部地壳结构。作者对背景噪声数据应用双波束形成（DBF）和地动位移振幅比（HVSR）方法，基于瑞雷面波频散曲线构建了三维剪切波速度（VS）模型。该模型清晰地描绘了盆地边界断裂，并在断裂交汇处发现了低速异常，指示了结构复杂性和流体活动。结果表明，盆地基底东深西……

sum: This study investigates how pore fluid properties affect dynamic slip and thermal pressurization (TP) in Groningen sandstone fault gouges. Using intermediate-velocity (0.05 m/s) rotary-shear experiments under undrained conditions, the authors compared four pore fluids: water, brine, 1 cSt, and 5 cSt silicone oils. Although TP dominated weakening in all cases, fluids with higher thermal expansivity (brine) and lower hydraulic diffusivity (5 cSt oil) unexpectedly produced less weakening than water and 1 cSt oil. Incorporating fluid-dependent permeability changes into model comparisons significantly improved the fit. The findings highlight that fluid properties and evolving gouge permeability are critical for determining TP efficiency during seismic slip.
本研究探讨了孔隙流体性质对格罗宁根砂岩断层泥动态滑动及热加压（TP）机制的影响。作者在无排水条件下进行了中等速度（0.05 m/s）的旋转剪切实验，对比了水、盐水、1 cSt和5 cSt硅油四种流体。结果表明，尽管热加压在所有情况下均主导了弱化过程，但具有较高热膨胀性的盐水和较低水力扩散率的5 cS……

t: Intermediate-velocity (0.05 m/s) rotary-shear experiments on simulated Groningen sandstone gouges under undrained conditions with four distinct pore fluids.
在无排水条件下，使用四种不同孔隙流体对格罗宁根砂岩模拟断层泥进行中速旋转剪切实验。
Experimental mechanical data and simulated fault gouges derived from the Groningen gas reservoir, saturated with water, brine, and silicone oils.

证明了孔隙流体的化学与物理性质显著影响动态滑动过程中热加压的效率。

阐明了与流体相关的渗透率演化在热加压数值模拟与预测中的关键作用。

Undrained pore fluid pressure testing using four distinct fluids (water, brine, 1 cSt, and 5 cSt silicone oils).

sum: This paper introduces a novel approach for classifying volcanic seismicity by employing Recurrence Quantification Analysis (RQA). RQA is used to extract physically interpretable, non-linear dynamical features from volcanic seismic waveforms. These features are then utilized in a multi-class classification framework to distinguish between different types of volcanic events. The methodology aims to bridge the gap between black-box machine learning models and physical interpretability in volcano monitoring, providing a robust tool for real-time hazard assessment.
本文提出了一种利用递归量化分析（RQA）对火山地震活动进行分类的新方法。该方法从火山地震波形中提取具有物理可解释性的非线性动力学特征，并将其应用于多分类框架中以区分不同类型的火山事件。该研究旨在弥合黑盒机器学习模型与火山监测中物理可解释性之间的差距，为实时灾害评估提供有力工具。

sum: This paper presents the first comprehensive application of the ten-attribute Distance and Quadrant (DQ) suite for reservoir characterization across four distinct geologic and AVO settings, including gas sands and CO2 storage. The workflow generates attributes directly from migrated near- and far-angle stacks without requiring prior well calibration or wavelet estimation. It serves as an effective preliminary screening tool for structural, stratigraphic, and machine learning analyses.

sum: This study characterizes Quaternary vertical deformation across the Septentrional Oriente Fault Zone (SOFZ) in northern Haiti by mapping and quantifying the elevations of uplifted coastal terraces. The results show contrasting deformation patterns on either side of the SOFZ, featuring significant spatial and temporal uplift gradients. These are driven by superimposed long-wavelength tilting and short-wavelength folding. North of the SOFZ, an eastward uplift gradient indicates that the accretionary prism accommodates much of the oblique convergence. South of the SOFZ, a southward tilt of the terraces in the northwestern peninsula of Haiti is attributed to isostatic effects from the underthrusting of thicker North American continental crust. This work provides key insights into how oblique plate convergence is partitioned and accommodated along active plate boundaries.
本研究通过对海地北部塞普滕特里奥纳尔断裂带（SOFZ）两侧隆升海岸阶地的详细制图与高程定量分析，揭示了第四纪垂直变形特征。结果表明，SOFZ两侧存在显著的隆升梯度差异，由深部大波长倾斜与浅部短波长褶皱叠加而成。断裂带以北的向东隆升梯度表明增生楔消纳了大部分斜向汇聚；断裂带以南的向南倾斜则反映了俯冲的……

t: Detailed geomorphological mapping and elevation quantification of Quaternary uplifted coastal terraces to analyze spatial and temporal deformation gradients.
对第四纪隆升海岸阶地进行详细的地貌制图和高程定量化，以分析时空变形梯度。

sum: This study presents an 8500-year paleoseismic record from a 13.5-m-deep trench at the Wuzunxiao site on the Altyn Tagh fault (ATF), Northwest China. The authors identified thirteen paleoearthquakes, yielding an average recurrence interval of 601±529 years and a coefficient of variation of 0.90, indicating weak quasi-periodic (irregular) recurrence behavior. Comparing these events with adjacent records shows that 17–36% of ruptures breached the Pingding Shan geometric barrier to co-rupture with the Xorkoli section. This passing probability matches predictions from a logistic model based on fine-scale historical surface rupture maps. The findings suggest that the alternating pattern of single-section and multi-section joint ruptures is controlled by the Pingding Shan earthquake gate, providing critical constraints for regional seismic hazard assessments.
本研究通过在阿尔金断裂带五尊肖遗址开挖13.5米深的探槽，重建了过去8500年来的古地震记录。识别出13次古地震事件，平均复发间隔为601±529年，变异系数为0.90，表明存在弱准周期（不规则）复发特征。对比邻近段落记录发现，有17-36%的地震事件越过了平顶山几何障碍，与相邻的索尔库里段发生联合……

An 8500-year stratigraphic and chronological record from a 13.5-m-deep trench at the Wuzunxiao site, alongside regional paleoseismic catalogs and historical rupture maps.
来自阿尔金断裂带中部五尊肖遗址13.5米深探槽的8500年地层与年代学数据，以及区域古地震目录。
Thirteen paleoearthquakes identified with an average recurrence interval of 601±529 years (COV of 0.90), showing that 17–36% of events breached the Pingding Shan barrier.

sum: This study conducts a 36-year time-series analysis (1990–2025) to evaluate the role of extreme rainfall in triggering phreatic eruptions and magmatic activity at Shinmoedake volcano, Japan. By introducing a new 'T&I Day' index (defined by daily rainfall ≥100 mm), the paper establishes a statistical correlation between intense precipitation events and volcanic unrest. The results suggest that rapid rainwater infiltration alters pore pressure and thermal regimes in the shallow hydrothermal system, acting as a critical external trigger for phreatic activity.

sum: This paper presents the first results from the Coupled atmospHere Interior modeL Intercomparison (CHILI) project, benchmarking planetary evolution codes for the primordial magma oceans of Earth and Venus. The study reveals that nominal Earth models predict magma ocean solidification within 4 Myr, whereas Venus scenarios show prolonged magma ocean stages up to 50 Myr. The intercomparison highlights that model-specific treatments of volatile partitioning, vertical energy transport, mantle geodynamics, convection, melting curves, rheological properties, and radiative transfer introduce substantial variance in cooling timescales and outgassed atmospheres. It identifies critical sensitivities in volatile partitioning, escape processes, mantle viscosity, and melting, which are essential for validating early planetary histories and interpreting exoplanet observations.

sum: This study investigates the application of the generalized mean rupture distance (Rp) to ground-motion models (GMMs) for large subduction interface earthquakes. By recalibrating the path term of a published GMM (Parker et al., 2022) using Rp derived from distributed slip models (DSMs), the authors show that incorporating spatially variable slip information fits strong-motion data at least as well as traditional Rrup-based models. The Rp-based approach successfully addresses near-fault ground-motion saturation and reduces model uncertainty, particularly for peak ground velocity (PGV) and acceleration, by accounting for the entire rupture geometry rather than assuming uniform slip.

sum: This study quantifies the late Quaternary slip rate along the northern segment of the Yangsan Fault (YSF) in southeastern Korea, a slowly deforming intraplate strike-slip fault. By integrating high-resolution LiDAR data, historical aerial photographs, optically stimulated luminescence (OSL) dating, terrace-riser restoration, and paleoseismic trench observations, the authors identify offset fluvial terraces with a dextral horizontal offset of ~19.03 m. Five OSL ages from the T2 terrace yield a weighted mean age of 103.14 ± 3.17 ka, constraining a minimum dextral slip rate of 0.15–0.23 mm/yr. This rate highlights along-strike segmentation and distributed deformation, suggesting that slip rates along the YSF are highly variable and influenced by fault-zone complexity rather than being uniform.

sum: This paper proposes an integrated data-driven time-series modeling framework for seismic activity prediction. It combines the Neural Hierarchical Interpolation for Time Series Forecasting (N-HITS) algorithm with the Gray Langurs Optimizer (GLO) for adaptive hyperparameter optimization. Benchmarked against state-of-the-art models, the optimized N-HITS model achieved a coefficient of determination (R2) of 0.95 and a significantly reduced Mean Squared Error (MSE) of 7.980e-05. The study demonstrates that metaheuristic optimization substantially improves the stability and accuracy of catalog-based statistical seismic trend monitoring, though it notes the limitation of relying solely on historical catalogs without physical drivers.

该模型纯粹依赖统计学目录趋势，缺乏物理构造或地球物理驱动机制。
Integrating hierarchical deep learning (N-HITS) with metaheuristic optimization (GLO) specifically for seismic catalog forecasting.

提出了一种用于地震活动性预测的新型层次深度学习-元启发式优化范式（N-HITS与GLO结合）。
证明了与独立深度学习模型相比，使用GLO进行系统超参数优化可显著降低预测误差。
构建了一种基于历史地震目录的高稳定、可扩展的统计地震趋势监测架构。

sum: The 2020 southwestern Puerto Rico seismic sequence, featuring a mainshock of Mw 6.4, caused significant damage but lacked consensus on its fault source. This study presents high-resolution marine seismic reflection data identifying a 20 km long, north-verging curved normal fault (the Guayanilla Canyon fault) that likely ruptured during the Mw 6.4 event. The fault bounds a 1 km deep asymmetric basin and controls the Guayanilla canyon system. The data do not support previously proposed major faults in the area. Additionally, imaging of the Investigator fault reveals buried low-angle thrusts, representing the boundary between the inactive upper accretionary prism of the Muertos trough and a buried back-arc basin.
2020年波多黎各西南部发生Mw 6.4地震序列，但其发震断层一直存在争议。本研究利用高分辨率海洋地震反射剖面，识别出一条长约20公里的北倾弧形正断层（瓜亚尼亚峡谷断层），该断层极有可能是Mw 6.4地震的破裂源。该断层控制着一个深约1公里的不对称盆地及瓜亚尼亚峡谷系统的发育。数据否定了此前该区域存……

t: High-resolution marine seismic reflection profiling combined with sediment isopach and magnetic anomaly mapping to image active fault structures.
结合高分辨率海洋地震反射剖面、沉积物等厚图和磁异常图对活动断层进行成像。
High-resolution marine seismic reflection profiles, sediment isopach maps, and magnetic anomaly maps of the southwestern offshore region of Puerto Rico.
波多黎各西南部海域的高分辨率地震反射剖面、沉积物等厚度数据和磁异常图。
Identification of the 20 km long Guayanilla Canyon fault as the source of the Mw 6.4 earthquake, and reinterpretation of the Investigator fault as a major tectonic boundary.
确定20公里长的瓜亚尼亚峡谷断层为Mw 6.4地震源，并将调查者断层重新解释为板块边界。
Lack of direct co-seismic slip measurements on the seafloor to uniquely resolve the contribution of strike-slip versus normal faulting components.
缺乏直接的海底同震滑动观测，难以完全厘清正断层与走滑断层分量的具体贡献。
Discovery of the Guayanilla Canyon fault and the refutation of previously proposed major seismogenic faults (e.g., Northern Boqueron Bay-Punta Montalva fault) in the epicentral area.
首次发现瓜亚尼亚峡谷断层，并否定了该区域先前假定的多条大型发震断层。

Refuted the existence of several previously proposed major seismogenic faults in the region.
Imaged the Investigator fault to re-interpret it as a boundary between an inactive accretionary prism and a buried back-arc basin.
识别出20公里长的瓜亚尼亚峡谷断层，并确定其为2020年Mw 6.4地震的主要发震构造。

sum: This paper presents a hybrid phase-field fracture framework to model crack initiation and propagation in heterogeneous wellbore systems with weak interfaces. Through numerical experiments, the authors isolate the effects of casing eccentricity and cement-formation interface strength. They find that casing eccentricity reduces crack initiation pressure by up to 30% and drives shear-induced inclined cracks beyond a 50% eccentricity threshold. Weak interfaces (≤30% bulk strength) deflect radial cracks along the interface, delaying stress relaxation and promoting additional radial cracking. A 3D simulation demonstrates depth-dependent crack nucleation and stress-shadowing effects, highlighting the framework's capability to capture complex wellbore failure mechanisms.
本文提出了一种混合相场断裂框架，用于模拟具有弱界面的非均匀井筒系统中的裂缝萌生与扩展。通过数值模拟，研究了套管偏心距和水泥-地层界面强度对裂缝发育的影响。结果表明，套管偏心使裂缝萌生压力降低高达30%，并在偏心距超过50%时引发剪切斜向裂缝。弱界面（≤30%基体强度）会使径向裂缝沿界面偏转，延迟应力……

t: A hybrid phase-field fracture framework designed to model crack initiation, propagation, and deflection in heterogeneous wellbore systems with weak interfaces.
一种混合相场断裂框架，用于模拟具有弱界面的非均匀井筒系统中的裂缝萌生、扩展和偏转。
Numerical experiments and 3D simulations evaluating the effects of casing eccentricity and cement-formation interface strength on wellbore integrity.
评估套管偏心距和水泥-地层界面强度对井筒完整性影响的数值模拟实验与三维模拟。
Casing eccentricity reduces crack initiation pressure by up to 30%, and interfaces with <30% bulk strength deflect radial cracks along the interface.

First application of a hybrid phase-field model to capture 3D depth-dependent crack nucleation and stress-shadowing along eccentric wellbore interfaces.

开发了适用于具有弱界面的非均匀井筒系统的混合相场断裂模拟框架。

确定了50%的临界偏心距阈值，该阈值会触发局部剪切驱动的倾斜裂缝。
证实了弱水泥-地层界面会使径向裂缝发生偏转，从而增加了持续套管压力的风险。

Three-dimensional simulation of depth-dependent crack nucleation and coalescence along the cement-formation interface.

sum: This study addresses the discrepancy between static harmonic theory and experimental observations regarding the Raman and infrared anomalies of $\delta$-AlOOH under pressure. By combining harmonic phonon calculations with SCAN-based deep-potential molecular dynamics and phonon quasiparticle analysis at 300 K, the authors extract temperature- and pressure-dependent frequencies and lifetimes. They successfully capture the branch reorganization and rapid linewidth growth in the disordering regime. Incorporating quasiparticle renormalization and directional LO-TO splitting yields near-quantitative agreement with ambient-pressure OH-stretching Raman spectra, demonstrating that finite-temperature dynamical effects and spectral coherence loss drive the spectroscopic signatures of H-bond symmetrization.
本研究解决了静态谐振理论与实验观测之间关于$\delta$-AlOOH在压力下拉曼和红外异常的差异。作者结合谐振声子计算、基于SCAN的深度势能分子动力学以及300 K下的声子准粒子分析，提取了温度和压力相关的频率与寿命。该方法成功捕捉到了无序化阶段的能带重组和谱线宽度快速增加。引入准粒子重整化和方……

t: Combining harmonic phonon calculations with SCAN-based deep-potential molecular dynamics and phonon quasiparticle analysis to extract temperature- and pressure-dependent frequencies and lifetimes.
结合谐振声子计算、基于SCAN的深度势能分子动力学和声子准粒子分析，提取温压相关的声子频率与寿命。
Simulated long-time molecular dynamics trajectories of $\delta$-AlOOH at 300 K under various pressures to capture branch reorganization and spectral coherence loss.
在300 K和不同压力下模拟的$\delta$-AlOOH长时间分子动力学轨迹，用以捕捉能带重组和相干性丧失。
Achieved near-quantitative agreement with the ambient-pressure OH-stretching Raman multiplet and explained the 5-10 GPa spectroscopic anomalies of H-bond symmetrization.
计算结果与常压下OH拉伸拉曼多重峰达到近乎定量吻合，成功解释了5-10 GPa下的光谱异常。
The analysis is primarily presented for 300 K, which does not fully cover the high-temperature conditions of the deep Earth.
模拟主要在300 K温度下进行，尚未全面覆盖深部地球的高温高压环境。

First application of deep-potential molecular dynamics combined with quasiparticle renormalization to resolve the temperature- and pressure-dependent spectroscopic signatures of H-bond disorder in $\delta$-AlOOH.
首次将深度势能分子动力学与准粒子重整化结合，阐明了有限温度动力学效应在氢键对称化中的主导作用。

SCAN-based deep-potential molecular dynamics (DPMD).
Phonon quasiparticle analysis at finite temperatures (300 K).

Calculated Raman and infrared spectra of $\delta$-AlOOH for comparison with experimental literature.

计算了$\delta$-AlOOH的拉曼和红外光谱，并与实验文献进行了对比。

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the detailed abstract of the paper, which outlines the methodology (SCAN-based deep-potential molecular dynamics, quasiparticle analysis), the target mineral (delta-AlOOH), and the key findings regarding H-bond symmetrization.

sum: This study introduces a novel formulation of the elastic wave equation based on acceleration and strain-rate, specifically tailored for Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) simulations. Analogous to the conventional velocity-stress framework, this system of first-order, coupled partial differential equations allows direct modeling of strain-rate wavefields without requiring post-simulation data conversion. Numerical validation using finite-difference simulations in complex media demonstrates that the proposed method achieves accuracy equivalent to traditional velocity-stress methods while minimizing computational overhead and simplifying integration into existing seismic modeling tools.

sum: This study demonstrates a novel method to detect and track silent marine mammals using Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) on seabed fiber-optic cables. While traditional passive acoustic monitoring relies on whale vocalizations, this approach detects the low-frequency hydrodynamic pressure and velocity fields induced by a whale's physical motion. Using ships as proxies for calibration and adapting a fluid mechanical model, the authors successfully detected multiple silent blue whales diving within 40 meters of the fiber cable, showing that these hydrodynamic signals decay as one over distance cubed. This method opens new avenues for monitoring endangered marine species.
本研究提出了一种利用海底光缆分布式声学传感（DAS）探测和追踪静音海洋哺乳动物的新方法。传统的被动声学监测依赖于鲸鱼的发声，而该方法通过探测鲸鱼运动引起的低频流体动力学压力和速度场来实现探测。作者利用船舶作为代理进行校准，并结合流体力学模型，成功探测到在光缆40米范围内潜水的多个静音蓝鲸，并证实这些……

sum: This study presents an empirical pre-whitening analysis of archival trackline and multibeam bathymetry profiles across the Atlantic, Pacific-Antarctic, and East Pacific Rise. The author identifies periodic signals embedded within otherwise aperiodic abyssal hills across half-spreading rates of 1 to 9 cm/yr. The detected periods range from tens of thousands to millions of years. Crucially, for half-spreading rates up to ~4 cm/yr, these periodicities are negatively correlated with the spreading rate, whereas no correlation exists at higher rates. This spreading-rate dependence and high scatter suggest that the periodic signals are intrinsically generated by volcanic processes, while the background aperiodic morphology is dominated by faulting.

sum: This paper proposes a physics-aware unsupervised deep-learning framework acting as a deep inverse operator to separate fundamental and higher modes of surface waves in the time-space domain. The method utilizes an adaptive Gaussian mask constructed in the frequency-phase-velocity (f-v) domain. Physical constraints are integrated into the loss function to maximize energy concentration within the target mask while suppressing leakage outside it. Through backpropagation, the network learns the inverse mapping without requiring labeled training data. Numerical experiments on synthetic and field data demonstrate that this framework provides a robust, automated solution for surface-wave mode separation, facilitating more reliable dispersion-curve picking and improving subsequent shear-wave velocity inversion accuracy.

sum: This study investigates the source process of the April 20, 2026, Mw 7.5 Off-Iwate earthquake in northeastern Japan using a joint inversion of strong-motion and geodetic data. The estimated slip distribution reveals large slips at depths of 20–35 km, overlapping with the rupture areas of the 1960, 1989, and 2011 off-Iwate events. This indicates the repeated rupture of a common interplate asperity. The study suggests that postseismic deformation from the 2011 Tohoku earthquake accelerated stress accumulation on this recurrent asperity, shortening its recurrence interval and enhancing coseismic slip in 2026.

sum: This paper investigates the competition between atmospheric escape and replenishment via outgassing during the magma ocean crystallization phase of young rocky exoplanets. The authors extend a coupled interior-atmosphere model by incorporating an energy-limited atmospheric escape module, comparing radiative-convective and prescribed-convective atmospheres. They find that atmospheric escape shortens magma ocean lifetimes by weakening greenhouse insulation. Additionally, volatile dissolution into the magma ocean interacts with escape to chemically fractionate the planetary volatile budget over time, retaining more soluble species. The mantle redox state remains a primary control on the retained atmospheric composition, with high oxygen fugacity yielding H2O- and CO2-rich atmospheres, and low oxygen fugacity producing H2- or CO-dominated atmospheres.

sum: This study introduces the Tripartite Spatiotemporal Triggering Hypothesis (TSTH) to explain far-field earthquake triggering across different spatial and temporal scales. It categorizes remote triggering into three distinct mechanisms: Antipodal Resonance (~20,000 km, days to months, driven by PKP-wave focusing and free oscillations); Plate-Margin Symmetric-End Stress Transfer (>1,000 km, 1–3 years, mediated by slow slip events and relay transfer); and Conventional Plate-Margin Compressional Transfer. By establishing these frameworks, the paper challenges traditional views that confine significant triggering to the near field, offering a new spatiotemporal correlation test for cross-scale remote triggering.

sum: This paper presents a comprehensive linear system identification (SID) study of the iconic UC San Diego Geisel Library building using acceleration data recorded during six low-intensity earthquakes. The authors employ five distinct input-output and output-only SID methods to cross-validate results, enhance noise robustness, and identify thirteen vibration modes. They evaluate potential soil-structure interaction (SSI) effects and the influence of rotational seismic base excitations using 3-DOF and 6-DOF models. The identified natural frequencies and damping ratios are compared with ambient vibration data and an uncalibrated finite element model. The results reveal slight decreases in natural frequencies and increases in damping ratios with higher response amplitudes, establishing a high-quality experimental-numerical baseline for future structural health monitoring and Bayesian model updating.

sum: This study investigates the principal slip zone of a major thrust in the fossil Boso accretionary wedge, Japan, which experienced thermal pressurization. Microscopic observations reveal a complex layered structure, including turbulent-flow-like layers. By applying hydrodynamic modeling (Couette-Poiseuille flow), the authors estimate an ultralow viscosity of 1.2 × 10^-4 to 2.3 × 10^-3 Pa s during fluidized granular flow. This coseismic fluidization and ultralow viscosity significantly enhance fault weakening and promote large stress drops, contributing to larger slip and rupture propagation during shallow subduction earthquakes.
本文对日本房总增生楔化石主滑动带进行了微观观测与分析。研究发现该滑动带具有复杂的层状结构，包括类湍流层。通过假设Couette-Poiseuille流进行流体动力学模拟，估算出热压作用引起的流体化颗粒流在共震期间的粘度极低（1.2 × 10^-4至2.3 × 10^-3 Pa s）。这种超低粘度显著……

t: Microscopic observation of fault rock layers combined with hydrodynamic modeling assuming Couette-Poiseuille flow to estimate coseismic viscosity.

Estimated coseismic viscosity of the fluidized fault material ranges from 1.2 × 10^-4 to 2.3 × 10^-3 Pa s.

sum: This paper presents MUSIC (multisite integrated chronologies), an open-source probabilistic toolbox designed to integrate paleoseismic event-age probability density functions (PDFs) from multiple trench sites into a single, unified earthquake chronology. The framework utilizes the Bhattacharyya coefficient to quantify the overlap of contemporaneous event PDFs, enabling systematic correlation of ruptures across sites. It then applies a weighted-mean method to combine these overlapping PDFs, yielding narrower age uncertainties than conventional averaging. Applying MUSIC to the central-eastern Altyn Tagh Fault (ATF), the authors reconstruct earthquake recurrence intervals using Monte Carlo simulations. They identify a regular increase in earthquake frequency during clustering periods. Given an elapsed time of ~370 years, the results suggest an elevated probability of an Mw 7.0+ earthquake on the central-eastern ATF in the coming decades, highlighting the tool's value for seismic hazard assessment.
本文介绍了开源工具包 MUSIC，用于将多个探槽场地的古地震事件年龄概率密度函数（PDF）整合为统一的地震活动年表。该框架利用巴氏系数定量评估不同场地地震PDF的重叠度，并采用加权平均法合并重叠的PDF，从而比传统方法获得更窄的年龄不确定性。作者将该方法应用于阿尔金断裂带中东段，通过蒙特卡洛模拟计算……

sum: This study investigates temporal variations in shallow subsurface seismic velocity ($dv/v$) and relative attenuation ($dQ^{-1}$) in the Taklimakan Desert from 2017 to 2019 using three broadband seismographs. Velocity changes are estimated via Rayleigh wave ellipticity (H/V) analysis, while attenuation variations are derived from road traffic-generated seismic signals. The results show clear seasonal fluctuations, with velocity changing by up to 4% and attenuation by up to 10%. These variations strongly correlate with temperature fluctuations with negligible time delay, indicating that thermoelastic strain governs long-term changes. Additionally, transient wetting events cause sharp drops in both velocity and Q, consistent with reduced frame stiffness and increased attenuation from wave-induced fluid flow. This highlights the dominant role of environmental forcing on desert subsurface properties.
本研究利用2017-2019年塔克拉玛干沙漠的宽频带地震数据，通过瑞利波椭圆率分析和交通噪声研究了浅表波速与衰减的季节性变化。结果表明，波速和衰减变化分别达4%和10%，且与温度波动高度相关，表明热弹性应变主导了长期变化。此外，降雨事件导致波速和Q值急剧下降，反映了水分引起的骨架刚度降低和流体流动衰……

sum: This paper presents a comprehensive environmental characterization of the Bedretto underground laboratory in Switzerland, situated under more than 1400 m of granite overburden. The authors measure cosmic-muon, gamma-ray, and neutron fluxes, alongside radon concentration, magnetic-field power spectra, and seismic backgrounds. They find that the muon flux is suppressed by six orders of magnitude, and both magnetic and seismic noise levels are exceptionally low. These findings demonstrate that the Bedretto tunnel meets the stringent low-vibration and low-background requirements for next-generation fundamental physics experiments, such as atom-interferometric gravitational-wave detection.
本文对瑞士Bedretto地下实验室（覆岩超1400米）进行了全面的环境背景测量。团队测量了宇宙线μ子、伽马射线和中子通量，以及氡浓度、磁场和地震背景噪声。结果表明，μ子通量被削弱了六个数量级，且磁噪声和地震背景噪声极低。这些测量证实该站点满足下一代引力波探测等实验对极低振动环境的严苛要求。

sum: This paper introduces the first systematic application of graph-based retrieval augmented generation (GraphRAG) to raw, tabular earthquake catalogs. By constructing queryable knowledge graphs from three distinct datasets (a reservoir swarm, the 2019 Ridgecrest sequence, and the 2021 Maduo Mw7.4 aftershocks), the pipeline enables open-ended natural language queries without manual data structuring. The authors address LLM hallucinations with seismology-informed prompt fixes, which eliminate fabrications and improve reasoning. Compared to vector RAG baselines, GraphRAG excels at catalog-wide summarization and temporal stage comparison, offering a practical, low-cost query interface for seismological catalogs.

sum: This study utilizes 3-D thermomechanical modeling to investigate the feedback between deformation and thermal structure during the initiation of the Lesser Antilles subduction zone. By incorporating elasticity, creep, and non-associative plastic flow, the authors demonstrate that deformational heating prior to slab development is unexpectedly strong. Plate buckling generates a high topographic ridge and a 200 K positive thermal anomaly beneath the Moho, thinning the conductive boundary layer. This thermal structure explains the potential location of volcanic arc initiation and partial melting zones, aligning with local tomographic and petrological observations.
本研究采用三维热机械模拟，探讨小安的列斯俯冲带启动中变形与热结构的反馈。模型引入弹性、蠕变和塑性流动，发现俯冲前变形生热异常强烈。板块弯曲产生高地形脊，并在莫霍面下方形成约200 K的正热异常，使导热边界层变薄。该热结构解释了火山弧启动和局部熔融的潜在位置，与层析成像和岩石学观测吻合。

sum: This study presents a modular kinematic rupture generator for physics-based ground-motion simulations (PBS). It models final slip, rupture speed ratio, and peak slip velocity as mutually correlated spatial fields. Using the spectral-element code SPEED, the authors simulate the June 2000 Mw 6.5 and 6.4 earthquakes in South Iceland, extending results to broadband using an artificial neural network (ANN2BB). Validation shows good agreement with recorded waveforms. Stochastic Mw 6.5 and Mw 7 scenario ensembles are generated, revealing that Mw 7 scenarios diverge from extrapolated local ground-motion models. This highlights significant epistemic uncertainty in large-magnitude, short-distance scaling where observations are sparse, demonstrating the framework's utility for region-specific hazard assessment.

sum: This paper presents a Modified Nearly Analytical Discretization (MNAD) method for Reverse Time Migration (RTM) to address numerical dispersion and high computational costs in large-scale seismic imaging. By simultaneously solving the wavefield and its spatial gradient fields, MNAD enables the use of coarser grids and compact stencils. Additionally, a novel boundary condition interpolation using MNAD gradient fields is proposed to mitigate spatial aliasing in data sampled below the Nyquist rate. Synthetic and ocean bottom seismometer (OBS) data applications demonstrate that the MNAD-based RTM achieves high-resolution imaging with significantly reduced computational, storage, and acquisition costs compared to conventional finite-difference methods.
本文提出用于逆时偏移的改进近解析离散化（MNAD）方法。通过同时求解波场及其空间梯度场，该方法允许在粗网格上进行高分辨率成像，显著降低计算与存储成本。此外，提出基于MNAD梯度场的新型边界插值方法，有效抑制了欠采样数据的空间混叠。合成与海底地震仪数据应用证实了该方法在降低计算和采集成本方面的优势。

sum: The authors determined the thermal equations of state of hydrated stishovite and CaCl2-type SiO2 up to 100 GPa and 3,000 K using machine-learning-based atomistic simulations. They investigated three hydrogen dissolution mechanisms (hydrogarnet-type, interstitial H2O, and coupled Al3+ + H+ substitution) to assess the gravitational stability of hydrated SiO2 and basaltic crust in the lower mantle. The results show that hydrogen dissolution decreases SiO2 density and reduces bulk sound velocity in the upper part of the lower mantle. Hydrated basaltic crust (1–4 wt% H2O in SiO2) remains 1%–2.4% denser than the ambient mantle, allowing it to sink to the lowermost mantle. Conversely, stishovite with 0.3–2.2 wt% H2O is neutrally buoyant at 730–800 km, explaining low shear-wave velocity layers in subduction regions. This study provides key insights into deep-mantle water transport.

sum: This paper extends the classic Occam's inversion framework, which traditionally uses l2 smoothing, to incorporate l1 regularization techniques such as lasso fusion, overcomplete dictionaries, and isotropic total variation. By bridging geophysics with modern statistics and imaging, the author unifies the mathematical formulations of three popular l1 solvers: coordinate descent, iteratively reweighted least squares (IRLS), and split Bregman. The methods are evaluated on linear (1D regression, 2D deblurring) and nonlinear (1D airborne electromagnetic) problems. The results demonstrate that coordinate descent is highly effective for 1D problems, while IRLS outperforms split Bregman for 2D problems, requiring up to an order of magnitude fewer least-squares solves.
本文将传统的l2平滑Occam反演框架扩展到包含lasso fusion、超完备字典和各向同性全变分（TV）的l1正则化方法。作者建立了地球物理反演与现代统计学/图像处理的联系，统一了坐标下降、迭代重权重叠最小二乘（IRLS）和分裂Bregman三种常用l1求解器的数学框架。通过一维回归、二维去模糊……

sum: This paper presents a novel true 3D gravity inversion method based on spectral-domain pseudo-inverse theory. To address the severe underdetermination caused by the lack of vertical wavenumber information in surface observations, the author utilizes Laplace's equation to analytically continue surface data upward, constructing a 3D data volume. By unitarily diagonalizing the Green's function of the 3D Poisson equation, a stable inverse filter is designed with proven bounded stability and consistency. The method reduces the computationally expensive 3D inversion to a single forward 3D Fourier transform, one spectral scaling, and one inverse transform. Validation on a homogeneous sphere model demonstrates accurate recovery of anomaly locations. The framework is highly efficient and generalizable to other linear potential-field problems like magnetic inversion.

sum: This paper presents a 3D Bayesian variational surface wave tomography method that directly inverts frequency-dependent traveltime measurements for 3D seismic velocity structures. To overcome the high computational cost of traditional Monte Carlo methods in high-dimensional spaces, the authors implement and compare three variational inference techniques: mean-field automatic differential variational inference (mean-field ADVI), physically structured variational inference (PSVI), and stochastic Stein variational gradient descent (sSVGD). Tested on both synthetic and real datasets from Southwest China, the results demonstrate that while all three methods accurately estimate mean velocities, sSVGD provides superior uncertainty quantification by avoiding the restrictive Gaussian assumptions of ADVI and PSVI. The variational approach yields higher-resolution velocity structures and reliable uncertainty estimates compared to traditional linearized methods.

sum: This study presents a novel wavefield separation and signal enhancement method using the Stockwell transform (ST), which offers frequency-dependent resolution. By implementing polarization filtering and non-linear thresholding in the ST domain, the author successfully enhances linearly polarized P and S signals while suppressing elliptically polarized Rg waves (and vice versa). To address the issue of polarization filtering enhancing polarized noise, non-linear ST thresholding is applied as a post-processing step. Testing on a dataset of approximately 2,700 local and regional waveforms demonstrates a median signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) improvement of ~8.8 dB compared to raw data, significantly outperforming polarization or frequency filtering alone (~0.3–1.3 dB).

sum: This study utilizes the dense broadband Formosa Array in northern Taiwan to characterize seismic ambient noise sources, directionality, and slowness. By combining power spectral density-probability density functions (PSD-PDFs) with time-domain delay-and-sum beamforming (0.1–0.4 Hz), the authors identify secondary microseisms (0.2–1 Hz) and high-frequency cultural noise (>1 Hz). During Typhoon Mitag, beamforming tracks storm-related coastal microseism excitation. The 10-minute mean beam power correlates strongly (Pearson ~0.8) with significant wave heights from nearby buoys, lagging by 6–7 hours. This suggests microseism sources develop offshore along incident wave directions. The study demonstrates that dense onshore arrays can effectively monitor environmental and oceanic processes, complementing oceanographic observations while supporting future ambient-noise imaging.

sum: This study investigates the relationship between crustal deformation, topographic tilting, and drainage network arrangement in the Cantabrian Mountains (NW Iberia). By analyzing two geomorphic indices of drainage asymmetry across a 300 km long segment, the authors evaluate tectonic tilting at two distinct spatio-temporal scales: short-wavelength tilting associated with discrete, ancient Alpine faults (hectometric to kilometric scale) and long-wavelength tilting driven by a modern lateral gradient in crustal thickness (kilometric scale). The results demonstrate that geomorphic indices can successfully identify major Alpine structures through their long-term landscape impacts, while also capturing the regional influence of active, larger-wavelength crustal deformation on modern drainage patterns. This highlights the utility of drainage network analysis in characterizing both past and ongoing tectonic processes.

sum: This study presents a revised tectonic model of the Western North Panama Deformed Belt (NPDB) by analyzing the structural and seismological characteristics of the April 22, 1991, Limon, Costa Rica (Mw 7.7) earthquake. The Limon earthquake, a major back-arc thrust event, provides critical constraints on the active deformation, fault geometry, and slip distribution along the Caribbean-Panama plate boundary. By integrating historical seismicity, structural geology, and geodetic observations, the authors refine the understanding of how strain is partitioned and accommodated in this complex deformed belt, offering new insights into regional seismic hazards.

sum: This study presents a six-segment kinematic back-slip plate boundary model for the Krafla volcanic system in Iceland, constrained by GNSS (2002–2024) and Sentinel-1 InSAR (2015–2023) data. Using Bayesian inversion, the authors determine the plate boundary axis, spreading rate, and locking depths. The locking depth is shallowest within and just north of the Krafla caldera (~1–2 km) and deepens to the north and south, matching seismicity and indicating an up-doming brittle-ductile transition. After correcting for glacial isostatic adjustment and regional subsidence, residual vertical velocities reveal local deflation at the Krafla and Bjarnarflag geothermal fields and the northern 1975–1984 lava field. The novelty lies in the long-term joint geodetic constraint and detailed segment-by-segment characterization of the volcano-tectonic plate boundary.

sum: This study systematically investigates the solubility of H2O and Al2O3 in stishovite and post-stishovite at 14–27 GPa and 1,500–2,300°C using multi-anvil experiments, SIMS, and FTIR. The results show that post-stishovite can incorporate significantly more H2O (1.1–2.0 wt.%) and Al2O3 (8.6–15.1 wt.%) than stishovite. Both solubilities increase with pressure and temperature. The compositional dependence of the stishovite to post-stishovite transition pressure suggests that chemical heterogeneity can shift the transition depth by several hundred kilometers, providing a robust explanation for the broad vertical distribution of mid-mantle seismic scatterers.

sum: This paper presents a novel joint exploration framework integrating cosmic-ray muon detection with seismic measurements to overcome the trade-off between density and elastic constants (bulk and shear moduli) in seismic velocity. Using Gassmann's fluid substitution model, the authors first demonstrate how incorporating independent density information improves pore gas saturation predictions. They then validate the method experimentally at the laboratory scale using muon and ultrasonic data collected on acrylic and aluminum blocks. By converting muon flux into density length, they successfully decompose P- and S-wave velocities into their constituent density and elastic parameters. This laboratory proof-of-concept demonstrates the feasibility of combining muography and seismology for enhanced reservoir characterization.

sum: This paper introduces a deep residual full-waveform inversion (FWI) pipeline that overcomes the acquisition-geometry memorization issue of direct data-to-model neural networks. Instead of raw shot gathers, the network inputs geometry-invariant, physics-derived model-space representations (starting model, classical inversion, misfit gradients, and fast-marching illumination maps). The learned model acts as a residual corrector to this physics prior. To ensure reliable uncertainty quantification, a six-member heterogeneous ensemble with per-pixel variance heads is calibrated using physics-conditioned conformal prediction. Additionally, a 'held-out-shot physics audit' rescales predictive intervals out-of-distribution without ground truth. Validated on 1,000 synthetic models and tested zero-shot on the Marmousi-2 model, the method reduces error by 38% over classical priors and maintains robust coverage under various data corruptions, outperforming gather-based baselines.

sum: This paper presents a novel, training-free, and computationally inexpensive method for local earthquake detection and P-wave arrival identification using Benford's Law. By analyzing the first-digit distribution of seismic amplitudes in a sliding window, the authors show that earthquake waveforms conform to Benford's Law during the onset of seismic energy, whereas background noise does not. The method is tested on continuous seismic data from two distinct tectonic regions in India: the intraplate Deccan Volcanic Province and the active Himalayan region. The results demonstrate that Benford-derived statistical anomalies align closely with theoretical P-wave arrival times, with performance primarily controlled by the window length. This approach offers a parameter-light alternative to traditional and machine-learning-based detection algorithms.

sum: The paper develops a discrete event modeling framework to investigate how geophysical systems progress toward catastrophic failure through sequences of distinct damage events. By representing system evolution as a succession of temporally accelerating and amplitude-varying events, the model demonstrates that both logarithmic and power-law finite-time singularities naturally emerge from shrinking interevent intervals and growing event magnitudes. A mean-field damage-based formulation links these power-law exponents to the evolving stiffness of the system under stress. Incorporating stochastic fluctuations captures natural randomness, leading to stochastic finite-time singular behavior. This framework provides a unified physical foundation for interpreting precursory signals (e.g., accelerating strain rate, event frequency) across various catastrophic phenomena, including landslides, glacier breakoffs, and volcanic eruptions, thereby improving hazard forecasting.

sum: This paper addresses the challenge of automating the structural consistency between reflecting horizon surfaces and tectonic fault networks in 3D digital geological modeling. Utilizing Mallet's Discrete Smooth Interpolation (DSI), the author demonstrates that classical formulations with dynamic weak constraints suffer from gradient descent instability. To resolve this, a heuristic approach is introduced that restricts the search space to vertically co-oriented triangulated surfaces, effectively reducing the 3D problem to a stable 2D finite element interpolation. A parametric model of topological consistency is developed using fault amplitude as a control parameter, and tested successfully on real geological models.
本文解决三维地质建模中层位与断层自动保持一致性的难题。基于Mallet的离散光滑插值，指出传统动态弱约束会导致梯度下降不稳定。为此提出一种启发式方法，将求解表面限制为垂直共定向三角面，将三维问题简化为稳定的二维有限元插值。开发了以断层幅度为控制参数的拓扑一致性模型，并在实际地质模型上成功测试。

sum: This study investigates the effects of asymmetric fault-adjacent topography on supershear rupture and fault branch intersections using 3D dynamic rupture simulations. By comparing a branch fault system with a flat free surface to one with topography under uniform traction, the authors demonstrate that topography causes free surface-induced supershear to propagate more slowly and asymmetrically. Depending on initial shear stress, normal stress perturbations from topography can completely suppress the daughter crack in the slower direction, resulting in unilateral supershear rupture. Additionally, topography can facilitate throughgoing rupture onto secondary segments at intersections. These findings provide a physical mechanism explaining why some strike-slip earthquakes lack supershear rupture.

sum: This paper presents a 3D fast sweeping eikonal solver for vertical transverse isotropic (VTI) media. By combining multiplicative factorization with a six-tetrahedron pyramidal stencil, the method successfully removes point-source singularities and enhances local accuracy. While factorization leads to complex quartic update equations on oblique stencil faces, the authors resolve this by applying Ferrari's method with a robust root-selection strategy. For horizontally constrained faces, the VTI Hamiltonian structure simplifies the system to a quartic equation, whereas mixed horizontal-vertical constrained faces are solved using a bisection-based iterative approach. Numerical tests demonstrate that this solver effectively suppresses source-related errors and significantly improves traveltime accuracy, making it highly suitable for seismic tomography and migration applications.

sum: This study investigates the phase stability and thermoelastic properties of (Fe,Al)OOH solid solutions under lower-mantle conditions using first-principles density functional theory (DFT) calculations. By modeling the ε-to-pyrite (Py) phase transition along cold slab geotherms, the authors demonstrate that aluminum incorporation significantly shifts the transition to higher pressures and broadens the transition interval (up to 20–30 GPa for 40–70% Al). Fe-rich compositions drastically reduce seismic velocities and increase density, whereas Al-rich compositions exhibit elastic properties similar to the ambient mantle. These contrasting seismic signatures suggest that compositional variations in slab-derived (Fe,Al)OOH can explain observed seismic heterogeneities near the core-mantle boundary (CMB). The novelty lies in quantifying the continuous solid-solution effects of Al on the ε-to-Py transition and its direct seismic expression.

sum: This study presents a stochastic modeling strategy to evaluate how internal fault geometry and segmentation control earthquake rupture sizes and recurrence. By combining quantitative fault zone characteristics with a kinematic model of rupture termination at relay zones, the authors perform sensitivity analyses on magnitude-frequency distributions (MFDs) and b-values. The model shows that decreasing segmentation and increasing fault maturity lead to larger ruptures and lower b-values. The method is validated using three distinct case studies: the Yushu-Ganzi-Xianshuihe fault system, the North Anatolian fault system, and induced seismicity from hydraulic fracturing in Ohio. The simulations show first-order agreement with observed seismicity, confirming that structural barriers like relay zones are key controls on maximum earthquake magnitudes, offering a valuable tool for improving seismic hazard assessments.

sum: This study applies the Seis-PickNet deep-learning model to build an expanded Pn-wave travel-time database for the southwestern United States. Using these high-quality picks, the authors perform Pn-wave travel-time tomography to construct a high-resolution velocity and anisotropy model of the uppermost mantle. The results reveal a strong correlation between active tectonic units, low-velocity anomalies, and strong anisotropy. Specifically, the model identifies independent thermal upwelling conduits beneath volcanic fields along the Colorado Plateau margins (e.g., Black Rock Desert, Uinkaret, and San Francisco volcanic fields) and supports the presence of ancient Farallon slab remnants beneath the central Great Basin. This work demonstrates how deep-learning-driven phase picking can significantly enhance the resolution of regional seismic tomography to image fine-scale mantle dynamics.

sum: This study performs full 3D waveform simulations for the largest recorded marsquake, S1222a, incorporating surface topography, lateral crustal thickness variations, and heterogeneous random media. By fitting waveform envelopes in the 0.04–0.08 Hz band, the authors show that crustal heterogeneities with 20–50 km correlation lengths and 30%–40% velocity perturbations are required to reproduce the observed long-period scattered surface waves. Accounting for these 3D scattering effects increases the estimated moment magnitude of S1222a to 4.7–4.9, which is 0.2–0.3 magnitude units higher than 1D estimates and consistent with normal mode observations. This demonstrates that neglecting 3D scattering systematically biases seismic energy release estimates on Mars.

It includes raw splitting catalogs, null station classifications, and pipelines for loading and filtering observations. A key feature is the implementation of H3 hexagonal spatial binning with backazimuth-resolved classification, which helps analyze directional anisotropy. Additionally, the repository contains figure generation scripts for creating dataset coverage maps, binning illustrations, and directional maps. sum: This paper proposes an adjoint-state-gradient coupled long short-term memory (LSTM) reparameterized framework for full-waveform inversion (FWI), compatible with both sequential-source (SQ) and simultaneous-source (SML) schemes. To overcome wavenumber discontinuity artifacts and high memory overhead in conventional deep learning FWI, the authors design an LSTM regularization scheme combined with phase-sensitive detection. This achieves crosstalk-free gradient calculations for multi-source cases. Numerical tests on Marmousi II, Overthrust, and Canadian Foothills benchmark models, along with field seismic data, demonstrate that the LSTM reparameterization significantly improves inversion accuracy. Specifically, the deep-learning-based SML FWI achieves imaging precision nearly identical to the SQ FWI while delivering over twofold computational acceleration, offering a flexible and efficient pipeline for field seismic data processing.

sum: This paper proposes a 'pulsating Earth' geodynamic model to resolve 31 systemic contradictions in plate tectonics. The model is driven by coupled thermoelectric, electrochemical, and thermodynamic feedback loops operating within Large Low Shear Velocity Provinces (LLSVPs) and Ultra-Low Velocity Zones (ULSVPs) at the core-mantle boundary. Thermal gradients generate thermoelectric voltages (Seebeck effect), augmented by phase transitions and iron redox reactions. These voltages drive electric currents, causing Peltier heating, adiabatic compression, and conductivity increases. The resulting self-sustaining thermal cycles drive periodic radial expansion (generating extensional tectonics) and contraction (generating compressional tectonics). Quantitative validation shows the system generates a magnetic flux of 1.916e25 lines and a radial expansion of 324.4 km over 20 million years, matching expected physical constraints.
